name: Mica Furniture Manufacturing., Inc
old_description: Experience 30 years of fabulous workmanship, dedication, and reliability when you put your trust in us. Your cabinetry, custom designs, home theater, office and bar needs are met with exceptional performance and customer service. Call today for your consultation.
about:
Based in Bridgeview, Illinois, Mica Furniture Manufacturing, Inc. has spent three decades building a reputation for custom cabinetry and furniture. The company emphasizes workmanship, dedication, and reliability in every project.

The shop produces custom cabinets and furniture for kitchens, bathrooms, home theaters, offices, and bars, as well as commercial interior spaces. Clients work with skilled technicians who create sketches and provide full dimensional views of each design before fabrication begins, ensuring every piece is made to order.

Mica serves both residential and commercial customers. Homeowners engage the company for kitchen and bath remodels, custom home theaters, and built-in bars, while businesses request tailored cabinetry for offices and professional environments. The firm handles projects ranging from single-room updates to complete commercial build-outs.

The company highlights its 30 years of experience as a differentiator, promoting exceptional performance, customer service, and a fully customized approach that moves from concept to finished product without relying on stock inventory.
